digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A declared-none child must be neutral in scope inheritance, contributing no paths and not poisoning sibling path declarations, unlike the current binary rule that treats empty path lists as undeclared and forces whole-HEAD invalidation.
Child scope impact must distinguish three live states (paths, none, undeclared) where undeclared poisons child inheritance and prevents whole-container all-none classification, but none does not.

Scope precedence must enforce exact ordering: own/cited/inherited dependency paths yield paths scope; else explicit parent none yields none; else all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to none; else unscoped, with parent paths never demoted to none.

P9 linting must pass declared-none leaves and containers whose live children are all declared, advising only live undeclared children as poisoners and naming both path declaration and --none as truthful remedies.

Cheap resign in resign.py must preserve child-derived signed scope without network reads by building direct-child state from immutable relation snapshot and passing it to sign_plan_review in an attested read session.
Mixed-scope signatures (paths and none children) must sign only path-child dependencies, survive unrelated file drift, and become stale only when a declared child path changes.
